## MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the Current Market Regime?
CAUTION: low volatility (Vol: 16.8%) versus narrow participation (Breadth: 2/8 sectors positive) — conflicting signals from calm index moves and concentrated winners.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Energy & Chemicals leading: TUPRS (1W: +9.87% | 1M: +42.70%) ABOVE TREND and PETKM (1W: +9.41% | 1M: +12.13%) ABOVE TREND; Retail & Food showing selective strength: SOKM (1W: +7.12% | 1M: +14.23%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Technology & Telecom and Banking & Finance are lagging with broad weakness: TCELL (1W: -6.42% | 1M: -5.41%) BELOW TREND and ISCTR (1W: -7.08% | 1M: -14.36%) BELOW TREND.

## STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
TUPRS (1W: +9.87% | 1M: +42.70%) ABOVE TREND, TRMET (1W: +9.48% | 1M: +20.96%) ABOVE TREND, PETKM (1W: +9.41% | 1M: +12.13%) ABOVE TREND, SOKM (1W: +7.12% | 1M: +14.23%) ABOVE TREND, ASELS (1W: +6.74% | 1M: -4.02%) RECOVERY.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
KONTR (1W: -11.86% | 1M: +15.56%) CORRECTION, TCELL (1W: -6.42% | 1M: -5.41%) BELOW TREND, TSKB (1W: -6.39% | 1M: -8.07%) BELOW TREND, TOASO (1W: -6.15% | 1M: -17.03%) BELOW TREND, FROTO (1W: -5.92% | 1M: -9.72%) BELOW TREND.

6. Momentum Stocks?
High positive momentum: TUPRS (1W: +9.87% | 1M: +42.70%) ABOVE TREND, TRMET (1W: +9.48% | 1M: +20.96%) ABOVE TREND, PETKM (1W: +9.41% | 1M: +12.13%) ABOVE TREND; high negative momentum: KONTR (1W: -11.86% | 1M: +15.56%) CORRECTION.

## SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Banking Sector Outlook?
Banking is under pressure and confirming weakness; AKBNK (1W: -2.26% | 1M: -16.71%) BELOW TREND, GARAN (1W: -2.87% | 1M: -11.16%) BELOW TREND, ISCTR (1W: -7.08% | 1M: -14.36%) BELOW TREND, TSKB (1W: -6.39% | 1M: -8.07%) BELOW TREND — avoid adding exposure.

8. Industrial Sector Outlook?
Mixed: EREGL (1W: +0.32% | 1M: +11.00%) ABOVE TREND and KRDMD (quant top-10) offer selective strength while FROTO (1W: -5.92% | 1M: -9.72%) BELOW TREND and TOASO (1W: -6.15% | 1M: -17.03%) BELOW TREND show cyclicality risk.

9. Energy & Chemicals Outlook?
Sector leadership but concentrated: TUPRS (1W: +9.87% | 1M: +42.70%) ABOVE TREND, PETKM (1W: +9.41% | 1M: +12.13%) ABOVE TREND, SASA (1W: +4.33% | 1M: +0.38%) ABOVE TREND — momentum intact, watch commodity and refinery catalysts.

## PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Cautious stance: trim broad beta and banking exposure, selectively add to proven momentum in Energy & Chemicals and high-quant retail names while keeping position sizing tight given narrow breadth.

## NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
TUPRS (1W: +9.87% | 1M: +42.70%) ABOVE TREND for momentum continuation, PETKM (1W: +9.41% | 1M: +12.13%) ABOVE TREND, TRMET (1W: +9.48% | 1M: +20.96%) ABOVE TREND, ASELS (1W: +6.74% | 1M: -4.02%) RECOVERY for rebound signals.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
Energy & Chemicals for leadership continuation and commodity sensitivity, Retail & Food for defensive demand stability, and Banking to gauge whether selling pressure broadens or stabilizes.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Monitor XU100 technical pivots (near-term support at recent lows and resistance at the multi-week highs) and watch catalysts: local CPI and monetary comments, global risk sentiment, crude oil moves and company-specific updates (TUPRS refining news, banking earnings/asset quality).

EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
Cautionary market: low volatility but very narrow participation with Energy & Chemicals and selective Retail leading while Banking and Tech lag. Tactical overweight to high-conviction energy and select retail names, defensive sizing on banks and cyclical autos given breadth risk.
